gauge.note: An independent slice of REVOTT, anchored by its own Ztp. It is not derived from any other instance and stands on its own gauge.

sampled.why: Instantiated across the whole key domain. No real-world targets are attached and none are claimed.

relations.note: Observed relations to sibling slices, recorded because they are exact, not because either slice defines the other.

unresolved.year_to_instant: The gauge fixes Ztp as a decimal year, 2031.3738…, not as an instant. Converting a decimal year to a calendar moment needs REVOTT's own convention, which is not in the files read here. The epoch above was therefore calibrated against the sibling slice, whose Ztp/instant pair is known, giving a separation of exactly 5830 days and carrying its time of day, 11:28:41.739Z. Supply the native convention and this epoch is set directly from 853177/420 with no reference to any other slice.
